details.title: Long tones
details.lead: Slow notes to wake up the lips and warm the horn. Play each one softly with a steady, centered sound, and rest as long as the rest in the bar. Begin in the middle, go down, then up as far as the lips are ready for today.
facts: Middle: F4 down to B3, Low: B♭3 down to E3, Middle and low: F4 down to E3, Up: F4 to B♭5, Top: B♭5 to double high B♭6, Swells, soft to loud to soft: F4 down to E3
